trips.import.subtitle: Select the vehicle these trips belong to, then upload a CSV. Odometer values are interpreted in your current unit ({unit}).

trips.import.vehicleHelp: All rows in the uploaded CSV will be assigned to this vehicle.

trips.import.fileHelp: Max 5 MB. Dates in YYYY-MM-DD. Odometers as whole numbers in your current unit.
